messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm going to rewrite the function-invoke examples to use SDK-first snippets and canonical JSON-schema examples. plan: 1) swap inline ad-hoc examples with Python/JS SDK blocks, 2) add explicit structured-output JSONSchema + small sample responses, 3) add a migration note for the response envelope change. pinging reviewers and heads-up for link fixes. :eyes:
aj (sdk): SGTM. can you include both streaming and non-streaming snippets? also add a small helper in the JS sample showing `parseStructuredResponse` usage so devs have a one-liner to import.
samir (eng-ml): Important: keep the schema examples aligned with the runtime shape. we recently added `metadata.request_id` and `latency_ms` in the envelope — examples need that or QA will fail.
maria: yep — plan is to show a minimal example and a full example. minimal will be only the fields apps should rely on. full will include the metadata blob.
kai (devex): i'll help convert the old snippets to the new SDK snippet format. can you drop the current list of broken anchors? i can run the link-fix bot after PR lands.
maria: thanks — attaching the quick sample i'll put in the PR:```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.invoke(
  model="rw-invoke-1",
  function_name="get_user_profile",
  input="user: 1234"
)
# structured output parser
from redwood.parsers import parse_structured
result = parse_structured(resp)
print(result.payload)
```
this corresponds to the JSONSchema we want to surface: minimal shape `{"type":"object","properties":{"payload":{"type":"object"}}}` (we'll expand with examples in the docs page).
eva (qa): please add a tiny test that parses the schema sample using the parser lib. i can add it to the docs-e2e repo. catch: current parser rejects when `metadata` is present as extraProperties=false — we should allow metadata in the full example.
aj (sdk): i'll add a small snippet in the SDK showing permissive parsing vs strict parsing:```js
import {Client, parseStructured} from '@redwood/inference'
const c = new Client()
const r = await c.invoke({model: 'rw-invoke-1', function: 'get_user_profile', input: 'user:1234'})
// permissive parse
const parsed = parseStructured(r, {allowExtra: true})
console.log(parsed.payload)
```
maria: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/892 (WIP). reviewers requested: @aj, @kai, @samir. hoping for first pass by EOW.
docs-bot: link-checker queued for PR 892 — running anchor scan.
samir (eng-ml): small content nit — in the parsing section call out that function outputs can be arrays of objects and show a collapsing example (array -> map) so product folks don't assume single-object only.
maria: good call — will add an array example and a note about `nullable` elements.
kai (devex): i can also prepare the SDK snippet generation script so we don't hand-edit 6 files. i'll run it after PR is review-ready.
eva (qa): ETA for test update: tomorrow morning. can we gate merge on passing docs-e2e?
maria: yes. i'll add a checklist in the PR body with docs-e2e as a required status. also adding a short migration blurb under "what changed".
aj (sdk): tiny API ask — can parseStructured return a typed wrapper in TS? will add a follow-up PR to the SDK. not blocking.
maria: timeline: draft today, reviewers by EOW, docs-e2e + link-check green early next week, merge mid next-week. if anyone is blocked ping here. :thumbsup:
samir (eng-ml): i'll double-check the sample model params to ensure they match the runtime defaults (sequence length, truncation).
kai (devex): when you update the snippets please leave the old curl examples commented so we can remove them in a separate cleanup PR. less churn in the release notes.
maria: noted. last Q — any objection to normalizing the envelope field names to `type`/`payload` from `kind`/`body`? that will be a migration note but simpler long-term.
aj (sdk): i'm okay with it if SDK still accepts the old names for 1 release (compat layer). i'll add compatibility shim.
samir (eng-ml): fine from infra side; ensure telemetry tags still land.
maria: perfect. i'll update the PR and post back here with the final link. thanks all! :rocket:
